title: UE actions upon going to RRC_IDLE

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: Radio Resource Control idle state where UE performs cell selection and monitors paging.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: Radio Resource Control inactive state where UE maintains connection context but uses less power.

entities.name: RRCRelease message
entities.description: Message that commands UE to release RRC connection and may include waitTime.

entities.name: Timer T302
entities.description: Timer used for access barring with duration set by waitTime in RRCRelease.

entities.name: Timer T320
entities.description: Timer for cell reselection priority information validity.

entities.name: Timer T390
entities.description: Timer used for access barring per access category.

entities.name: pendingRNA-Update variable
entities.description: Boolean variable indicating if RNA update is pending; set to false when entering RRC_IDLE.

entities.name: UE Inactive AS context
entities.description: Access Stratum context stored in RRC_INACTIVE; discarded when entering RRC_IDLE.

entities.name: suspendConfig
entities.description: Configuration for RRC connection suspension; released when entering RRC_IDLE.

entities.name: VarConditionalReconfig
entities.description: Stored conditional reconfiguration entries; all removed when entering RRC_IDLE.

entities.name: VarMeasConfig
entities.description: Stored measurement configuration; entries for condTriggerConfig report types removed when entering RRC_IDLE.

entities.name: Security keys
entities.description: K_eNB, K_gNB, RRCenc, RRCint, UPint, UPenc keys; discarded when entering RRC_IDLE.

entities.name: Radio resources
entities.description: RLC, BAP, MAC, PDCP, SDAP entities and configurations; released when entering RRC_IDLE.

relations.description: RRCRelease message with waitTime starts timer T302.
RRCRelease message with waitTime stops timer T302 if running.
Leaving RRC_INACTIVE stops timer T320 if running.
Leaving RRC_INACTIVE stops timer T390 for all access categories.
Entering RRC_IDLE sets pendingRNA-Update to false.
Entering RRC_IDLE discards UE Inactive AS context.
Entering RRC_IDLE removes all entries in VarConditionalReconfig.
Entering RRC_IDLE removes condTriggerConfig-related entries from VarMeasConfig.
Entering RRC_IDLE discards all security keys.
Entering RRC_IDLE releases all radio resources.
